extraction.notes: IRT reports no AFFO; its adjusted FFO metric is CFFO (Core FFO), so affo_total is null. Reconciliation taken from the three-months-ended June 30, 2023 column on page 14 (seq 28); it ties to the trailing-five-quarters table on page 13. Net income is before NCI; the NCI allocation is not part of the FFO bridge. Zero-value lines ('—') are included at 0. Loan premium accretion classified as debt_cost_amortization. Diluted shares = weighted-average shares and units 230,369,086 (converted to thousands); check: 65,264/230,369 = $0.28 and 63,682/230,369 = $0.28. Recurring capex of $6.4 million is from the Capital Expenditures paragraph (page 3, seq 5), a rounded figure given in millions; recorded as 6400 thousand. The company's own CFFO does not deduct it.
